_about: Phase 0 desired campaign settings, keyed by campaign key from config/ids.json. Only pl_value changes; the other three are already at the desired value on all six campaigns (snapshot 2026-09-21). Applied by apply_instantly_phase0.py via PATCH /campaigns/{id} together with the new sequences.

ui_only_notes.ai_smart_pause_ooo: "AI Smart Pause for OOO" is a UI toggle (Campaign > Settings > Auto-pause for out-of-office replies). It is not exposed by the v2 campaigns API, so it is on PHASE0_MANUAL_CHECKLIST.md. Keep stop_on_auto_reply=false so an OOO reply never kills the sequence.
ui_only_notes.variables: New merge variables ({{buildingType}}, {{metro}}) appear in Instantly only once a lead upload carries them. The validator treats them as warnings and the apply script refuses cleaning_trigger unless --allow-new-variables is passed and the list factory has populated them.
ui_only_notes.campaign_schedule: Five of the six campaigns send 07:00-19:00 America/Detroit with Saturday on (recruiting_outbound 08:00-17:00 America/Chicago). America/Detroit 07:00 is 06:00 CT, an hour before shared.settings.SEND_WINDOW opens, and the cadence never sends at weekends. The desired schedule below is 07:00-19:00 America/Chicago Mon-Fri and is patched with the sequences; campaign_schedule is in the PATCH allow-list in config/instantly_api_contract.md.

proof.reactivation: I built a similar system for a commercial roofer doing $150M/year. I recovered about $6M worth of contracts within 6 months.
proof.outbound: I recently implemented the same system for a commercial roofer doing $150M/yr and generated about $180,000 in new contracts in 90 days.
